title: The 5 Best Juicers for Leafy Greens
h1: The 5 Best Juicers for Leafy Greens
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for juicers for leafy greens, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at juicers for leafy greens using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Omega J8006HDS Masticating Juicer
products.blurb: Key specs: 80 RPM dual-stage auger, 200W motor, 37oz juice container.
strengths: Reverse switch clears fibrous greens that jam the auger without disassembly
15-year warranty is the longest in the category
Doubles as a food processor attachment for nut butter and baby food
limitations: Horizontal auger design takes up more counter length than upright juicers
Juice and pulp containers are small and need emptying often during a big greens batch
Slower overall throughput than a centrifugal juicer

products.name: Hurom H-AA Slow Juicer
products.blurb: Key specs: Single auger, upright design, 150W quiet motor, Adjustable pulp control lever.
strengths: One of the highest juice yields recorded across independent juicer tests, including on greens
Very quiet operation compared to most masticating juicers
Compact upright footprint compared to horizontal masticating designs
limitations: Premium price puts it well above most competitors, including the Omega
Narrower feed chute than the Omega means more pre-cutting for whole produce
More parts to assemble and clean than a simpler centrifugal juicer
features: Available in matte black, white, and rose gold

products.name: Breville Juice Fountain Cold
products.blurb: Key specs: 850W motor, Cold Spin Technology, 70oz juice jug.
strengths: Much faster than any masticating juicer when greens are only part of the mix
Cold Spin Technology keeps juice temperature rise under 2°F, slowing oxidation
Easy to rinse clean, a common praise point in owner reviews
limitations: Yield on pure leafy greens is noticeably lower than a masticating juicer
Greens need to be rolled or bunched with firmer produce to feed well
Louder motor than any masticating option on this list

products.name: NutriBullet Juicer Pro NBJ50200
products.blurb: Key specs: 1000W high-torque motor, 27oz sealing juice pitcher, 3-inch feed chute with dual-size pusher.
strengths: Lowest price of any juicer on this list with real fruit and vegetable capability
Wide feed chute reduces prep time for firmer produce
limitations: Weakest yield on leafy greens of the four juicers here
Some owners report excessive foam on high-water-content produce
Centrifugal blade wastes more greens than a masticating auger

products.name: Nama J2 Cold Press Juicer
strengths: Fewer parts to clean than many slow juicers

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
